title: Fortune 10 scientist with free-energy and teleportation technology

tellings.quote: guy flies in super genius he can build uh over free energy plasma things he can do teleportation

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who says UFO secrets are held by a hidden group of powerful people, says that in 2025 a scientist from a Fortune 10 company, one of the ten largest companies in the United States, flew in to Los Angeles to meet him. Greer describes the man as a "super genius" who can build free-energy plasma devices and do teleportation. If true, it would mean technology far beyond anything public already sits inside big business.
